Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Athens hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 28, 2026 snapshot, at 11 of the 17 Athens hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Agoda at 5, Traveluro at 3, Amimir.com at 1, Trip.com at 1 and Vio.com at 1. These are the Athens rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Athens hotels

At the 9 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 16% ($20 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 12% at Arion Athens Hotel to 17% at Hotel Plaka. At 8 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
